title: One-person FDE consultancy thesis
expected_artifacts: A complete FDE commercial thesis with coherent offer/pricing/channel alternatives, capacity and two-month cash records, client/production/professional handoffs and a bounded learning/commitment programme. Do not create unrelated outputs or replace source evidence with the assessment. A blocked commitment can still have a complete, useful design or review record.
reference_findings: One project uses 114 total month-one hours; two use 184, exceeding 120 by 64. One retainer uses 92 hours; two use 140, exceeding by 20. One project’s full valued-cost residual is 1960; one retainer’s is -720 under the same shared-cost assumptions. Project cash falls to -1200 before day 60 and closes 4800; the floor gap is 1700. Neither a signed project nor public contact detail supplies cash or outreach authority. The verifier checks the fixed arithmetic; direct review must also examine evidence scope, causal limits and the requested business reasoning. A favourable calculation alone does not pass all growth gates.
negative_control: Fail omitting sales/content/admin work, promising unlimited retainers, inventing extra staff, double-counting owner draws as labour expense, assuming every proposal converts or contacting all fifty people.
preservation: Keep one-person-only-v1 and bounded-reporting-integration-v1. A new retainer or payment proposal needs buyer/owner approval; a diagnosis cannot silently change existing scope or claim unearned proof.
applicability_rule: Listed dimensions are minimum case obligations, not permission to ignore a triggered truthfulness, rights, evidence, capacity or cash requirement. Other dimensions may be NOT APPLICABLE only with a case-scope reason; missing relevant evidence is BLOCKED for the business decision, not inapplicable.
